about_the_game:
Blades For Hire Demo opens the gates to an exciting world of mercenary guild management and tactical decision-making. Live the gripping story of a commoner striving for glory in a ruthless world.

In this demo, you’ll experience:

  • The Power of Choice: Complete unique missions where your decisions shape the course of events.

  • Tactical Battles: Discover an indirect control system for your fighters. Experiment with strategies and master key combat mechanics.

  • Mercenary Management: Recruit hardened warriors, equip them for high-risk missions, and train them to become elite fighters.

  • Economic Planning: Wisely allocate limited resources, pay wages, and invest in your guild’s growth—while preparing for the unpredictable expenses that come with a mercenary’s life.

This demo offers a glimpse into the core mechanics and atmosphere of Blades For Hire, letting you experience the weight of difficult decisions, strategic planning, and the intense adventure that awaits in the full game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 3 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GPU GeForce GTX 660 / AMD GPU Radeon R9 270X
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX9 Compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 3.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 680 / AMD Radeon R9 280X
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX9 Compatible

short_description: Experience the gripping world of "Blades For Hire" with our exclusive demo! Lead your mercenary guild through challenging missions, make impactful decisions, and engage in strategic combat. Guide your guild to prosperity—or ruin—as you navigate the harsh realities of a mercenary’s life.
